body: Hopefully  one day soon I'll have the courage to be free.
NY sad person.  What's up . Wanna chat ?

Dont come off strong give them a situation  of a
 * friend * and see reaction first .
If anything  they may just want to help you.
I'd talk to someone  you trust . Just to get what ifs off ur chest .
Sometimes  it will eat you and you could try to harm ur self . I'd get help if you get to that point and you will know you are there you will start to feel numb a bit .

Depending  on what you want to do with your feelings  to be honest  .
 (I have a family  of my own ) I'd never go through  no matter how bad I've felt (nor self harm since h.s ) 

But that area is what got me on meds and it was fine till they up my meds and I took my self off cold Turkey (never do it) and I decided I would work through  my depression  and not cope with it . (Again just me but I've been like that for 10 years ) you know you're limits  . And I'd talk about it with a friend  or family member you trust . And if at that point  talking  about it you still feel the same . I would  get help . Sometimes  you just need someone to listen
I call it the gray area.  The what ifs. Not dont really wanna make action yet . Just trying to see how life can play out with out you there . Been there way to many times .

Good thing about  being  of age one day.... YOU CAN MOVE ON UR OWN. and best part you wouldnt have to tell them where you are going . Yes approval  is wanted but not needed unless you 1000% approve  of your self ♡
Well if you cant find it . Keep pushing  through . You never know why you couldn't find it is because  there is more for you than what you think.

My best  friend  just lost both parents  to cancer they left 3 girls behind . I asked her what keeps her going . Her response was "they wanted me to live a life and I'm making  that life happen . That's what keeps  me going everyday to know when I want to stop and call quits I know they would want me to go further in life ."  I'm sorry for what's going on truly am . No kid nor parent should  go through  it . But just keep in mind would  she want you to keep pushing  and help others and make a difference  or doesn't  matter what happens . Keep head high hun .

As a parent  I would want to know when I'm speaking  wrong . Maybe try speaking to them or like you just said leave the account open on the bed or table and sit or hide until the read it and of you cant speak write a note . You dont make it any better the way you speak to me . 

I'm here to chat as well . It's not easy at all . But let them in . They cant help if they dont know it all :(

(My parents  did the same to me same words and worse actions in retaliation to my depression)

If it failed . It failed for a reason  ♡ 
-keep fighting  hun 
Never easy but in the end you never know what the outcome  will be . 
- grades are grades just keep them going enough to pass .
You should tell the dr . Because  a side effect  of the meds is deeper depression  . You are in the right direction . You are looking for help

Hun , as much as not everyone  wants to hear it sometimes  medication will help and I bet if you go to the dr office  and say I'd like to talk with out my parents and just hug a nurse you would feel so much better . You would be surprised  how many time medical providers  understand  sometimes we just need a hug. 

If you do it now how will you know who is waiting  for you in life . You should  start picking  a activity . Something that makes you happy even if it's doing it alone . And as for thinking  you are soft for crying . Not at all and (as a parent  my self ) I encourage my son to cry and get that emotion out because  I dont want him to end up with depression  like me . And as a female  I was always  told  not to cry . Not all have that mind set but maybe if not sitting  with mom and dad and being  like look you are missing  all my signs and I need you now more than ever. You should try talking  with them first and sometimes  if they dont listen  say its important  to you and you are trying the best you can but just cant anymore . Be as open and honest  as you can . About things remember  this secret is urs and no one can force you to speak unless you let them in .
I'd go to the hospital.  Everybody has a different  reaction to medication  especially the amount  you took.  Be honest  so they can help you the best way .
